title: BDB Startcycle Domain Profile
description: Schema for a domain profile in .agents/profiles/. A profile adapts the default seven-node /startcycle-graph pipeline to a non-software domain: it replaces build nodes, renames gates, and names domain artifacts. It is sugar around .agents/nodes.json — never parsed when absent, and the default software pipeline stays exactly as is. See .agents/graph.md, section 'Domain profiles (opt-in)'.

domain.description: Short lowercase kebab name of the domain, e.g. kicad. Matches the profile filename without .json.

nodes.description: Per-slot overrides keyed by a default registry node id (null = keep the default node as is) or by a free key for an added domain node slot. 'replace' lists registry node ids to drop; 'add' carries new node entries in the registry shape.

replace.description: Default registry node ids this slot drops.

gates.description: Shipping gate names for this domain, each mapping to a short human description of what passing means. Replaces the default lint/typecheck/tests/a11y/seo/security keys for this run.

artifacts.description: Artifact key -> path relative to the repo root, always under production_artifacts/.

selection.description: How the dispatcher or the Architect's plan gate picks this profile from the goal text.

triggers.description: Lowercase keyword strings typical for this domain. Triggers must be unique across profiles — a goal text hitting two domains' triggers is an ambiguity that must escalate, not a coin flip.

description.description: One-line summary used by the plan-gate decision and by humans browsing .agents/profiles/.

skills.description: Optional: domain-wide extra skills layered onto every node, on top of each node's own allowlist.

nodeEntry.description: A new node in the same shape as one .agents/nodes.json node entry.

role.description: Same role enum as the registry. 'gate' is Shipping's role; a profile cannot add a second shipping.

agentType.description: Compiled agent name — must exist as .claude/agents/<name>.md or as a node's agentType in .agents/nodes.json.

personaFile.description: Optional persona file path, as in the registry.

skills.description: Skill allowlist for this node; every name must exist as skills/**/<name>/SKILL.md.

artifactKey.description: Key this node writes into state.artifacts.

writes.description: state.d fragment path, as in the registry; null for sequential nodes.

instructions.description: Per-node prompt instructions, as in the registry.
